name: vice-after-dark-obs-overlays
description: A self-hosted OBS browser-source overlay set with live control panel

scripts.build:stinger: mkdir -p public/assets/stingers && node scripts/generate-stinger.js | ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f rawvideo -pixel_format rgba -video_size 960x540 -framerate 30 -i pipe:0 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=bilinear,format=yuva420p -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 35 -deadline good -cpu-used 5 -row-mt 1 -auto-alt-ref 0 -an public/assets/stingers/vice-red-stinger.webm
